<!doctype html>
<html lang="en" dir="ltr">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
  <title>INDTV</title>
  <meta name="description" content="INDTV — Indian live TV for Smart TV browsers. Public channels from the iptv-org India playlist.">
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#0e0b14">
  <meta name="color-scheme" content="dark">
  <meta name="referrer" content="no-referrer">
  <link rel="manifest" href="manifest.webmanifest">
  <link rel="icon" href="assets/icons/favicon.svg" type="image/svg+xml">
  <link rel="icon" href="assets/icons/icon-192.png" type="image/png" sizes="192x192">
  <link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="assets/icons/icon-192.png">
  <meta property="og:image" content="assets/icons/banner-1280x720.png">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://iptv-org.github.io" crossorigin>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Karantina:wght@400;700&family=IBM+Plex+Sans+Hebrew:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap">
  <style>/* INDTV — Flixgram family look: velvet room, projector light, content-coloured ambience.
   Layout concept: a 1920×1080 TV canvas expressed in rem (1rem = 16px at 1920 wide), so every
   proportion of the reference holds on any TV resolution. Single deliberate dark theme. */
:root {
  --bg: #0e0b14;
  --bg-2: #120e18;
  --surface: #1a1522;
  --surface-2: #251e2f;
  --orange: #fff3dd;
  --orange-warm: #ffd9b0;
  --text: #fff3dd;
  --text-2: #b9b0c4;
  --muted: #8e8599;
  --live: #ff4d5e;
  --line: rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.07);
  --line-2: rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.12);
  --glass: rgba(13, 18, 27, 0.72);
  --orange-glow: rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.24);

  --font-ui: 'IBM Plex Sans Hebrew', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
  --font-display: 'Karantina', 'IBM Plex Sans Hebrew', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif;
  --font-he: 'IBM Plex Sans Hebrew', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif;

  --topbar-h: 5.6rem;
  --rail-w: 5.25rem;
  --gutter: 7.6rem;           /* content start, clear of the side rail */
  --card-w: 21.5rem;
  --card-h: 11.8rem;
  --poster-w: 21.5rem;
  --poster-h: 14.4rem;
  --gap: 1.35rem;
  --ui-scale: 1;              /* Settings → Display size */
  --radius: 0.55rem;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(.2, .7, .2, 1);
  --focus-ms: 170ms;
  color-scheme: dark;

  font-size: calc(100vw / 120);
  font-size: calc(min(100vw / 120, 100vh / 67.5) * var(--ui-scale));
}

/* Phones / portrait: keep it readable rather than a microscopic TV canvas. */
@media (max-aspect-ratio: 1/1) {
  :root { font-size: calc(7px * var(--ui-scale)); --gutter: 2rem; --rail-w: 0rem; }
}

*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body { height: 100%; margin: 0; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); overflow: hidden; }
body {
  font-family: var(--font-ui);
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1.4;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
}
html[lang="he"] body { font-family: var(--font-he); }
button { font: inherit; color: inherit; background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; margin: 0; cursor: pointer; text-align: inherit; }
input, textarea { font: inherit; }
img { max-width: 100%; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }
h1, h2, h3, p { margin: 0; }
.ic { width: 1em; height: 1em; display: block; flex: none; }
/* base for every channel logo; placement classes below override position */
.logo { position: relative; display: block; }
:focus { outline: none; }
html:not(.kbd) .fx:focus-visible { outline: none; }

/* ===================== Wordmark ===================== */
.wordmark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; direction: ltr; }
.wordmark .wm-mark { width: 0.86em; height: 0.86em; color: var(--orange); margin-right: 0.18em; }
.wordmark .wm-ind { color: var(--text); }
.wordmark .wm-tv { color: var(--orange); }
.wm-xl { font-size: 4.2rem; }
.wm-hero { font-size: 8.6rem; }

/* ===================== App shell ===================== */
#app { position: fixed; inset: 0; }
.stage { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
.screen { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
.vscroll { height: 100%; overflow-y: auto; overflow-x: hidden; scrollbar-width: none; }
.vscroll::-webkit-scrollbar, .rail-track::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

/* screens slide in when a tab is opened with OK */
.screen.is-entering { animation: screen-in 280ms var(--ease) both; }
@keyframes screen-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translate3d(0, 1.4rem, 0); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
/* ----- Buttons ----- */
.btn {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 3.4rem; padding: 0 1.6rem; border-radius: 3rem;
  font-size: 1.32rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--text);
  transition: transform var(--focus-ms) var(--ease), box-shadow var(--focus-ms) var(--ease), background-color var(--focus-ms) var(--ease), border-color var(--focus-ms) var(--ease), color var(--focus-ms) var(--ease);
}
.btn .ic { font-size: 1.35em; }
.btn .ic + .btn-label { margin-inline-start: 0.6rem; }
.btn-primary {
  height: 4.6rem; min-width: 18rem; padding: 0 2.4rem; font-size: 1.55rem; font-weight: 600;
  background: linear-gradient(100deg, #E8364B 0%, #ff4d5e 35%, #FF6A3A 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 0.8rem 2.2rem rgba(242, 56, 74, 0.28);
}
.settings-scroll .btn-primary, .detail-actions .btn-primary, .status-actions .btn-primary, .empty .btn-primary, .add-form .btn-primary { height: 3.6rem; min-width: 0; font-size: 1.25rem; padding: 0 1.8rem; }
.btn-primary:focus { transform: scale(1.06) translateY(-0.12rem); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.16rem var(--text), 0 0 0 0.42rem rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.413), 0 1rem 2.6rem rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.225); }
.btn-ghost { background: rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.07); border: 0.09rem solid var(--line-2); }
.btn-ghost:focus, .btn-choice:focus { transform: scale(1.05); background: rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.12); border-color: var(--orange); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.1rem var(--orange), 0 0 1.8rem var(--orange-glow); }
.btn-icon-only { width: 4.6rem; height: 4.6rem; padding: 0; border-radius: 50%; }
.btn-icon-only .btn-label { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); }
.btn-icon-only .ic { font-size: 1.7rem; }
.btn-choice { background: rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.05); border: 0.09rem solid var(--line-2); color: var(--text-2); }
.btn-choice.is-on { color: var(--text); border-color: rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.45); background: rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.075); }
.btn-choice.is-on .ic { color: var(--orange); }
.btn-danger:focus { border-color: var(--live); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.1rem var(--live), 0 0 1.6rem rgba(242, 56, 74, 0.3); }

.progress { display: block; height: 0.22rem; border-radius: 1rem; background: rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.12); overflow: hidden; }
.progress-fill { display: block; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--orange), var(--orange-warm)); border-radius: 1rem; }
.progress-card { position: absolute; left: 0.9rem; right: 0.9rem; bottom: 0.55rem; }

/* ----- Logos ----- */
.logo-img { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: contain; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 260ms var(--ease); }
.logo.is-loaded .logo-img { opacity: 1; }
.logo-fb {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; display: none; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center;
  border-radius: 0.4rem; background: radial-gradient(80% 90% at 50% 40%, rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.06), rgba(14, 11, 20, 0) 70%);
}
.logo.is-failed .logo-img { display: none; }
.logo.is-failed .logo-fb { display: flex; }
.logo-fb-mono {
  font-family: var(--font-ui); font-weight: 800; font-size: 2.6rem; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  color: var(--text); padding-bottom: 0.25rem; border-bottom: 0.14rem solid var(--orange);
}
.logo-fb-name { margin-top: 0.45rem; font-size: 1.05rem; color: var(--text-2); max-width: 100%; padding: 0 0.4rem; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.logo-fb.no-name .logo-fb-mono { font-size: 1.5rem; }
.card-std .logo-fb-name, .card-grid .logo-fb-name, .card-poster .logo-fb-name { display: none; }

/* ----- Notices / states ----- */
.notice { margin: 0 var(--gutter) 1.4rem; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.8rem 1.1rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.06); color: var(--orange-warm); font-size: 1.02rem; }
.notice .ic { font-size: 1.3rem; margin-inline-end: 0.7rem; }
.home-state { padding: calc(var(--topbar-h) + 6rem) var(--gutter) 0; }
.loading-block { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 4rem; }
.loading-word { opacity: 0.95; }
.loading-bar { width: 16rem; height: 0.2rem; margin: 2rem auto 1.2rem; border-radius: 1rem; background: rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.1); overflow: hidden; }
.loading-bar span, .status-bar span { display: block; width: 40%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 243, 221, 0), var(--orange), rgba(255, 217, 176, 0)); animation: sweep 1.3s var(--ease) infinite; }
@keyframes sweep { from { transform: translateX(-100%); } to { transform: translateX(260%); } }
.loading-block p { color: var(--text-2); font-size: 1.15rem; }
.skeleton-rail { display: flex; margin-bottom: 2rem; }
.skeleton-card { flex: none; width: var(--card-w); height: var(--card-h); border-radius: var(--radius); background: linear-gradient(100deg, var(--surface) 20%, #141a26 50%, var(--surface) 80%); background-size: 200% 100%; animation: shimmer 1.6s linear infinite; }
.skeleton-card + .skeleton-card { margin-inline-start: var(--gap); }
@keyframes shimmer { from { background-position: 100% 0; } to { background-position: -100% 0; } }

.empty { max-width: 46rem; margin: 3rem auto; text-align: center; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; }
.empty-icon { font-size: 3.6rem; color: var(--orange); margin-bottom: 1.2rem; }
.empty-title { font-size: 1.9rem; font-weight: 600; text-wrap: balance; }
.empty-body { margin-top: 0.7rem; font-size: 1.15rem; color: var(--text-2); line-height: 1.55; }
.empty-actions { margin-top: 1.8rem; display: flex; }
.empty-soon { margin-top: 6rem; }

/* ===================== Generic screens ===================== */
.screen-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; padding: calc(var(--topbar-h) + 1.2rem) var(--gutter) 1.5rem; }
.screen-title { font-size: 3rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
.screen-sub { margin-inline-start: 1.2rem; font-size: 1.3rem; color: var(--muted); }
.grid-scroll, .settings-scroll { padding-bottom: 4rem; }
.grid {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, var(--card-w)); grid-gap: 1.5rem var(--gap);
  padding: 0.6rem var(--gutter) 2rem;
}
.grid-poster { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, var(--poster-w)); }
.grid-compact { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, 17.5rem); padding: 0.6rem 0 2rem; }
.grid-compact .card-grid { width: 17.5rem; height: 12.4rem; }
.grid-compact .card-grid .card-logo { inset: 2rem 2.2rem 4.4rem; }

/* ----- Settings ----- */
.set-section { margin: 0 var(--gutter) 2.6rem; max-width: 84rem; }
.set-title { font-size: 1.8rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 1rem; padding-bottom: 0.7rem; border-bottom: 0.07rem solid var(--line); }
.set-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; }
.set-row > * { margin-bottom: 0.7rem; }
.set-row > * + * { margin-inline-start: 0.8rem; }
.sources { margin-bottom: 0.8rem; }
.src-card { padding: 1.3rem 1.5rem 0.6rem; border-radius: 0.7rem; background: var(--surface); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.07rem var(--line); margin-bottom: 1rem; }
.src-card.is-off { opacity: 0.7; }
.src-head { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.src-head > * + * { margin-inline-start: 0.7rem; }
.src-name { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; }
.src-state { margin-inline-start: auto !important; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted); }
.src-state.st-ok { color: #57d68d; }
.src-state.st-error { color: var(--live); }
.src-state.st-loading { color: var(--orange-warm); }
.src-url { margin-top: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--text-2); font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.src-facts { margin-top: 0.4rem; font-size: 1.08rem; color: var(--muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.src-error { margin-top: 0.4rem; font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--live); }
.src-card .set-row { margin-top: 0.9rem; }
.set-form { display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-width: 52rem; }
.set-form > .field-label { margin: 0.9rem 0 0.45rem; font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--text-2); }
.set-form > .set-row { margin-top: 0.9rem; }
.add-form { padding: 0.6rem 1.5rem 1rem; margin-top: 0.4rem; border-radius: 0.7rem; background: var(--bg-2); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.07rem var(--line-2); }
.set-status { margin-top: 0.6rem; font-size: 0.98rem; color: var(--text-2); }
.about-text { font-size: 1.22rem; color: var(--text-2); line-height: 1.6; max-width: 60rem; }
.about-src { margin-top: 0.6rem; font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.92rem; color: var(--muted); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.about-text + .set-row { margin-top: 1.2rem; }
input[type="file"].field { padding-top: 0.75rem; }

/* ===================== Player ===================== */
.player { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 60; background: #000; overflow: hidden; }
/* the video never moves or resizes when the OSD appears */
.player-video { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: contain; background: #000; }
.osd, .osd-shade-top, .osd-shade-bottom { opacity: 0; transition: opacity 260ms var(--ease); pointer-events: none; }
.player.osd-on .osd, .player.osd-on .osd-shade-top, .player.osd-on .osd-shade-bottom { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
.osd-shade-top { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; height: 14rem; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(14, 11, 20, 0.88), rgba(14, 11, 20, 0)); }
.osd-shade-bottom { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 22rem; background: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(14, 11, 20, 0.94) 10%, rgba(14, 11, 20, 0)); }
.osd-top { position: absolute; top: 2.6rem; left: 3.6rem; right: 3.6rem; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; }
.osd-ch { display: flex; align-items: center; min-width: 0; }
.osd-logo { width: 8.4rem; height: 4.9rem; flex: none; position: relative; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.07); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.07rem var(--line-2); }
.osd-logo .logo { position: absolute; inset: 0.55rem 0.75rem; }
.osd-ch-text { margin-inline-start: 1.3rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; }
.osd-ch-name { font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.015em; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.osd-ch-cat { font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--orange-warm); }
.osd-badges { display: flex; align-items: center; flex: none; }
.osd-badges > * + * { margin-inline-start: 0.7rem; }
.osd-clock { font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-2); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.osd-muted { font-size: 1.5rem; color: var(--orange-warm); }
.osd-bottom { position: absolute; left: 3.6rem; right: 3.6rem; bottom: 2.4rem; }
.osd-prog { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; }
.osd-now, .osd-next { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; }
.osd-next { margin-inline-start: 3rem; opacity: 0.75; }
.osd-label { font-size: 0.85rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 600; }
html[lang="he"] .osd-label, html[lang="he"] .guide-label { letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
.osd-now-title { font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 600; margin-top: 0.2rem; }
.osd-next-title { font-size: 1.15rem; margin-top: 0.2rem; }
.osd-progress { margin-top: 1.1rem; display: flex; align-items: center; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.osd-progress .progress { flex: 1; height: 0.34rem; margin: 0 1rem; }
.osd-progress.is-live .progress-fill { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--live), var(--orange)); }
.osd-time { font-size: 1rem; color: var(--text-2); min-width: 3.5rem; }
.osd-progress.is-live .osd-time-a { color: var(--live); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; }
.osd-controls { margin-top: 1.2rem; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; align-items: center; }
.osd-main { display: flex; align-items: center; }
.osd-main > * + * { margin-inline-start: 1.6rem; }
.osd-secondary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; }
.osd-secondary > * + * { margin-inline-start: 0.6rem; }
.ctl {
  width: 4.2rem; height: 4.2rem; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 2.1rem; color: rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.86);
  transition: transform var(--focus-ms) var(--ease), background-color var(--focus-ms) var(--ease), box-shadow var(--focus-ms) var(--ease), color var(--focus-ms) var(--ease);
}
.ctl-main { width: 5.8rem; height: 5.8rem; font-size: 3rem; color: var(--text); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.1rem rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.28); }
.ctl-sm { width: 3.4rem; height: 3.4rem; font-size: 1.55rem; color: var(--text-2); }
.ctl:focus { color: var(--text); transform: scale(1.1); background: rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.1); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.1rem rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.6), 0 0 1.8rem rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.315); }
.ctl:focus .ic { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 0.5rem rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.413)); }
.ctl-main:focus { background: rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.12); }
.ctl.is-disabled { opacity: 0.35; }
.ctl.is-denied { animation: deny 380ms var(--ease); }
@keyframes deny { 25% { transform: translateX(-0.3rem); } 75% { transform: translateX(0.3rem); } }
html[dir="rtl"] .osd-main, html[dir="rtl"] .osd-progress { direction: ltr; }

.player-status { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; pointer-events: none; }
.status-card { pointer-events: auto; text-align: center; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding: 2.2rem 3rem; border-radius: 1rem; background: rgba(18, 14, 24, 0.82); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.07rem var(--line-2); max-width: 46rem; }
.status-loading { background: none; box-shadow: none; }
.status-bar { width: 14rem; height: 0.2rem; border-radius: 1rem; overflow: hidden; background: rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.12); }
.status-text { margin-top: 1rem; font-size: 1.15rem; color: var(--text-2); }
.status-icon { font-size: 3rem; color: var(--orange); }
.status-title { margin-top: 0.9rem; font-size: 1.9rem; font-weight: 700; }
.status-body { margin-top: 0.6rem; font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--text-2); line-height: 1.55; }
.status-note { margin-top: 0.8rem; font-size: 0.98rem; color: var(--orange-warm); line-height: 1.5; }
.status-actions { margin-top: 1.6rem; display: flex; }
.status-actions > * + * { margin-inline-start: 0.9rem; }
.player[data-phase="loading"] .osd-shade-bottom { opacity: 1; }

/* ===================== Toast ===================== */
.toast {
  position: fixed; z-index: 100; left: 50%; bottom: 3rem; transform: translate(-50%, 1rem); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
  padding: 0.9rem 1.6rem; border-radius: 3rem; background: rgba(18, 25, 38, 0.96); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.07rem var(--line-2), 0 1rem 2rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  font-size: 1.35rem; transition: opacity 200ms var(--ease), transform 200ms var(--ease); white-space: nowrap;
}
.toast.is-on { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, 0); }
.toast-error { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.1rem var(--live), 0 1rem 2rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); }

/* hide chrome while watching (player covers it anyway; saves paint on TVs) */
html.is-watching #app { visibility: hidden; }
/* inside the Android TV app the player is already full screen */
html.is-native .ctl[data-key="ctl:fs"] { display: none; }

/* ===================== Portrait / phone fallback ===================== */
@media (max-aspect-ratio: 1/1) {
  .siderail { display: none; }
  .topbar { padding: 0 1rem; flex-wrap: nowrap; }
  .tb-brand { min-width: 0; margin-inline-end: 1rem; }
  .tb-nav { overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: none; margin: 0; }
  .tb-nav::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
  .tb-lang .lang-sep, .tb-lang .lang-opt:not(.is-on) { display: none; }
  .hero-art { display: none; }
  .hero-copy { width: auto; right: 2rem; }
  .live-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding: 0 2rem; }
  .live-col-cats, .live-detail { display: none; }
  .search-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding: 0 2rem; }
  .promo-panels { display: none; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 1ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 1ms !important; }
}

/* ===================== What's on now (programme guide) ===================== */
.card-now {
  position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 1; padding: 0.5rem 1.1rem 0.6rem;

.tile.is-off::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0.3rem; inset-inline-start: 0.6rem; width: 0.9rem; height: 0.9rem; border-radius: 50%; background: #6b6474; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.2rem var(--velvet); }
.tile-name {
  margin-top: 0.9rem; max-width: calc(var(--disc) + 3rem); font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--lamp); text-align: center;
  white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; unicode-bidi: plaintext; opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-0.3rem);
  transition: opacity 200ms var(--out), transform 200ms var(--out);
}
.tile:focus .tile-disc { transform: scale(1.12); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.24rem var(--velvet), 0 0 0 0.5rem var(--lamp), 0 0 2.6rem rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.35), 0 1.4rem 3rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); }
.tile:focus .tile-name { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
.tile-fav { position: absolute; top: 0.1rem; inset-inline-end: 0.5rem; width: 1.9rem; height: 1.9rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--velvet); color: var(--rose); display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 1.05rem; z-index: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.12rem var(--velvet); }
.tile-rec { position: absolute; top: 0.4rem; inset-inline-start: 0.6rem; width: 1rem; height: 1rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--live); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.2rem var(--velvet); z-index: 1; animation: rec-pulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite; }
.tile-sm { --disc: 7rem; }
.tile-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, calc(var(--disc) + 1.4rem)); grid-gap: 0.6rem 1.5rem; padding: 0.8rem var(--edge) 3rem; justify-content: start; }
.tile-grid .tile { height: calc(var(--disc) + 3.3rem); }
.tile-grid-sm { --disc: 7rem; }
.tile-pick .tile-check { position: absolute; top: 0; inset-inline-end: 0.4rem; width: 2rem; height: 2rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--lamp); color: var(--velvet); display: none; place-items: center; font-size: 1.1rem; z-index: 2; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.15rem var(--velvet); }
.tile-pick.is-on .tile-check { display: grid; }
.tile-pick:not(.is-on) .tile-disc { filter: saturate(0.5) brightness(0.7); }
.tile-pick.is-on .tile-name { opacity: 1; transform: none; color: var(--lamp); }

/* =====================================================================
   Rails (Home, favourites, catch-up)
   ===================================================================== */
.rail { position: relative; margin-bottom: 0.6rem; }
.rail-head { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 var(--edge); }
.rail-dot { width: 0.75rem; height: 0.75rem; border-radius: 50%; margin-inline-end: 0.85rem; flex: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0.8rem currentColor; }
.rail-title { font-size: 1.9rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.005em; font-family: var(--font-ui); }
.rail-meta { margin-inline-start: 1rem; font-size: 1.3rem; color: var(--haze); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.rail-more {
  margin-inline-start: auto; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1.1rem; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--haze);
  border: 0.07rem solid transparent; transition: background-color 200ms, color 200ms, transform 200ms var(--out);
}
.rail-more:focus { background: var(--lamp); color: var(--velvet); transform: scale(1.06); }
.rail-track {
  display: flex; overflow-x: auto; overflow-y: visible; scrollbar-width: none;
  padding: 1.3rem var(--edge) 0.6rem; scroll-padding: 0 var(--edge);
}
.rail-track::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
.rail-track > * { flex: none; }
.rail-track > * + * { margin-inline-start: 1.5rem; }
.rail-tiles .rail-track { min-height: calc(var(--disc) + 4.6rem); }
.rail-cards .rail-track { padding-bottom: 1.4rem; }

/* =====================================================================
   Home — hero follows the highlighted channel
   ===================================================================== */
#screen-home .hero { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 19.5rem; padding: 1.4rem var(--edge) 0; pointer-events: none; }
.hero-text { max-width: 74rem; opacity: 0; transform: translate3d(0, 0.6rem, 0); }
.hero-text.in { opacity: 1; transform: none; transition: opacity 220ms var(--out), transform 300ms var(--out); }
.hero-sub { font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--haze); min-height: 2.2rem; }
.hero-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.6rem; line-height: 0.88; margin: 0.4rem 0 1rem;
  white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; text-shadow: 0 0.4rem 2.5rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35); unicode-bidi: plaintext;
}
.hero-title.long { font-size: 7rem; line-height: 0.95; }
html[dir="rtl"] .hero-title { text-align: right; }
.hero-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: 1.38rem; color: var(--lamp); min-height: 2rem; }
.hero-meta > span + span { margin-inline-start: 1.1rem; padding-inline-start: 1.1rem; border-inline-start: 0.07rem solid var(--dust); }
.hero-meta .hero-now { font-weight: 600; unicode-bidi: plaintext; }
.hero-fav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; color: var(--rose); }
.hero-fav .ic { margin-inline-end: 0.45rem; }
.home-rows { position: absolute; top: 19.5rem; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: auto; padding-bottom: 6rem; }
.home-state { padding: 6rem var(--edge) 0; }
.notice { margin: 0 var(--edge) 1rem; }

/* =====================================================================
   Pages (catch-up, favourites, recordings, settings)
   ===================================================================== */
.page-scroll { padding-bottom: 5rem; }
.page-head { padding: 1.2rem var(--edge) 1.2rem; }
.page-title { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.2rem; line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: 0.005em; }
.page-sub { margin-top: 0.7rem; font-size: 1.35rem; color: var(--haze); max-width: 90rem; }
.section-title { padding: 1.6rem var(--edge) 0.2rem; font-size: 1.9rem; font-weight: 600; }
.section-empty { padding: 0.6rem var(--edge) 1rem; font-size: 1.25rem; color: var(--haze); max-width: 80rem; }
.empty { margin: 4rem auto; }
.empty-icon { color: var(--lamp); opacity: 0.8; }
.empty-title { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 3.4rem; line-height: 1; }
.empty-body { color: var(--haze); }

/* =====================================================================
   Categories — side list (☰ folds it) + round logos + search
   ===================================================================== */
#screen-categories { display: flex; }
#screen-categories[hidden] { display: none; }
.cat-side {
  flex: none; width: 27.5rem; position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding-top: 0.6rem;
  border-inline-end: 0.07rem solid var(--dust);
  background: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(14, 11, 20, 0.75), rgba(14, 11, 20, 0.25));
  transition: width 360ms var(--out);
}
html[dir="rtl"] .cat-side { background: linear-gradient(to left, rgba(14, 11, 20, 0.75), rgba(14, 11, 20, 0.25)); }
.cat-side-head { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 1.5rem 1rem; }
.menu-btn { width: 3.75rem; height: 3.75rem; border-radius: 1rem; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--velvet-3); color: var(--lamp); flex: none; transition: transform 200ms var(--out), background-color 200ms; }
.menu-btn svg { width: 1.9rem; height: 1.9rem; }
.menu-btn:focus { background: var(--lamp); color: var(--velvet); transform: scale(1.08); }
.cat-side-title { margin-inline-start: 1.1rem; font-size: 1.45rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--haze); white-space: nowrap; }
.cat-list { flex: 1; min-height: 0; height: auto; padding-bottom: 4rem; }
.cat-row { display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; padding: 0.8rem 1.5rem; position: relative; transition: background-color 200ms var(--out); }
.cat-disc {
  width: 3.4rem; height: 3.4rem; border-radius: 50%; flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 85%, white), var(--c)); color: rgba(14, 11, 20, 0.8);
  font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.8rem; line-height: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.18rem rgba(14, 11, 20, 0.6);
}
.cat-row-text { margin-inline-start: 1.1rem; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; text-align: start; }
.cat-name { font-size: 1.42rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--haze); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.cat-num { font-size: 1.02rem; color: var(--haze); opacity: 0.7; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.cat-row.is-sel .cat-name { color: var(--lamp); font-weight: 600; }
.cat-row.is-sel::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset-inline-start: 0; top: 1rem; bottom: 1rem; width: 0.3rem; border-radius: 0 0.2rem 0.2rem 0; background: var(--lamp); }
.cat-row:focus { background: var(--lamp); }
.cat-row:focus .cat-name, .cat-row:focus .cat-num { color: var(--velvet); }
.cat-side.is-collapsed { width: 7rem; }
.cat-side.is-collapsed .cat-side-head { padding: 0 1.6rem 1rem; }
.cat-side.is-collapsed .cat-side-title, .cat-side.is-collapsed .cat-row-text { display: none; }
.cat-side.is-collapsed .cat-row { padding: 0.8rem 1.8rem; }
.cat-main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.cat-head { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; padding: 0.6rem var(--edge) 0.6rem 3.4rem; flex: none; }
.cat-head .chips { margin-top: 1.2rem; }
html[dir="rtl"] .cat-head { padding: 0.6rem 3.4rem 1.2rem var(--edge); }
.cat-head-text { min-width: 0; }
.cat-title { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 6.4rem; line-height: 0.9; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; max-width: 58rem; }
.cat-count { display: block; margin-top: 0.4rem; font-size: 1.3rem; color: var(--haze); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.chip-search-wrap { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; }
.chip-search-ic { position: absolute; inset-inline-start: 1.3rem; width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; color: var(--haze); pointer-events: none; z-index: 1; }
.chip-search { width: 22rem; padding-inline-start: 3.5rem; background: transparent; color: var(--lamp); font: inherit; font-size: 1.38rem; outline: none; }
.chip-search::placeholder { color: var(--haze); }
.chip-search:focus { color: var(--velvet); }
.chip-search:focus::placeholder { color: rgba(14, 11, 20, 0.55); }
.chip-search-wrap:focus-within .chip-search-ic { color: var(--velvet); }
.chip-search::-webkit-search-cancel-button { display: none; }
.cat-scroll { flex: 1; min-height: 0; height: auto; }
.cat-scroll .tile-grid { padding-inline-start: 3.4rem; }

/* =====================================================================
   Catch-up cards
   ===================================================================== */
.cu-card {
  display: flex; align-items: center; width: 34rem; height: 9.4rem; padding: 0 1.4rem; border-radius: 1.4rem;
  background: rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.05); border: 0.07rem solid var(--dust); text-align: start;
  transition: transform 220ms var(--out), background-color 220ms var(--out);
}
.cu-disc { --disc: 6.2rem; box-shadow: 0 0.5rem 1.2rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); }
.cu-info { margin-inline-start: 1.2rem; min-width: 0; flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.cu-title { font-size: 1.45rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; unicode-bidi: plaintext; }
.cu-ch { font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--haze); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; unicode-bidi: plaintext; }
.cu-time { font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--haze); margin-top: 0.2rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
html[dir="rtl"] .cu-title, html[dir="rtl"] .cu-ch, html[dir="rtl"] .rec-title, html[dir="rtl"] .card-show .wide-name { text-align: right; }
.cu-live { align-self: flex-start; margin-top: 0.35rem; }
.cu-info .progress { margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.cu-card:focus { background: var(--lamp); transform: scale(1.05); }
.cu-card:focus .cu-title, .cu-card:focus .cu-ch, .cu-card:focus .cu-time { color: var(--velvet); }
.cu-settings { padding: 0 var(--edge); max-width: 110rem; }
.set-toggle {
  display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; padding: 1.3rem 1.6rem; border-radius: 1.2rem; margin-bottom: 1.6rem; text-align: start;
  background: rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.05); transition: background-color 200ms var(--out), transform 200ms var(--out);
}
.set-toggle-text { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; }
.set-toggle-title { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; }
.set-toggle-sub { font-size: 1.15rem; color: var(--haze); margin-top: 0.25rem; }
.toggle { flex: none; width: 4rem; height: 2.2rem; border-radius: 2rem; background: rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.18); position: relative; transition: background-color 200ms; margin-inline-start: 1.5rem; }
.toggle::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0.25rem; inset-inline-start: 0.25rem; width: 1.7rem; height: 1.7rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--lamp); transition: inset-inline-start 200ms var(--out); }
.set-toggle.on .toggle { background: #1f8a50; }
.set-toggle.on .toggle::after { inset-inline-start: 2.05rem; }
.set-toggle:focus { background: var(--lamp); transform: scale(1.01); }
.set-toggle:focus .set-toggle-title, .set-toggle:focus .set-toggle-sub { color: var(--velvet); }
.set-toggle:focus .toggle:not(.on) { background: rgba(14, 11, 20, 0.2); }
.set-line { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 1.6rem; }
.set-line-title { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; margin-inline-end: 1.6rem; }
.set-line-col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }
.cu-settings .tile-grid { padding: 0.8rem 0 1rem; }
.cu-settings .set-status { font-size: 1.15rem; color: var(--haze); margin: 0.6rem 0 0; }

/* =====================================================================
   Favourites (my shows), recordings, settings
   ===================================================================== */
.show-list { padding: 0.8rem var(--edge) 1rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.show-row { display: flex; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 0.9rem; }
.show-row > * + * { margin-inline-start: 1rem; }
.card-show {
  display: flex; align-items: center; width: 44rem; height: 7.4rem; padding: 0 1.2rem; border-radius: 1.2rem; text-align: start;
  background: rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.05); border: 0.07rem solid var(--dust); transition: transform 200ms var(--out), background-color 200ms;
}
.card-show .wide-logo { width: 5.2rem; height: 5.2rem; border-radius: 50%; position: relative; flex: none; overflow: hidden; }
.card-show .wide-info { margin-inline-start: 1.1rem; min-width: 0; flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.card-show .wide-top { display: none; }
.card-show .wide-name { font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.card-show .wide-prog { font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--haze); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.card-show.is-live .wide-prog { color: #ff8a95; }
.card-show:focus { background: var(--lamp); transform: scale(1.03); box-shadow: none; }
.card-show.is-live { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.09rem rgba(255, 77, 94, 0.55); }
.card-show:focus .wide-name, .card-show:focus .wide-prog { color: var(--velvet); }
.rec-list { padding: 0.6rem var(--edge) 2rem; }
.rec-row { background: rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.05); box-shadow: none; border: 0.07rem solid var(--dust); border-radius: 1.4rem; padding: 1rem 1.4rem; }
.rec-disc { --disc: 5.6rem; margin-inline-end: 1.3rem; }
.rec-disc.is-rec { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.2rem var(--live); }
.rec-title { font-size: 1.5rem; unicode-bidi: plaintext; }
.rec-meta { color: var(--haze); }
.set-section { margin: 0 var(--edge) 2.6rem; }
.set-cats { margin: 0.4rem var(--edge) 1.8rem; }
.set-title { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 3rem; border-bottom: 0; padding-bottom: 0; margin-bottom: 0.8rem; }
.src-card { background: rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.05); border-radius: 1.2rem; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.07rem var(--dust); }
.add-form { background: rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.03); }
.field, .edit-input { border-radius: 0.9rem; }

/* =====================================================================
   Player OSD in the room's light
   ===================================================================== */
.ctl { position: relative; }
.ctl:focus { background: var(--lamp) !important; color: var(--velvet) !important; box-shadow: none !important; }
.ctl.is-on { color: var(--rose); }
.ctl:focus::after {
  content: attr(aria-label); position: absolute; top: calc(100% + 0.7rem); left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
  white-space: nowrap; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--lamp); background: rgba(14, 11, 20, 0.85);
  padding: 0.25rem 0.8rem; border-radius: 999px; pointer-events: none;
}
.osd-ch-name { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 3.4rem; line-height: 1; }
.osd-logo { width: 5.4rem; height: 5.4rem; border-radius: 50%; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 0.6rem 1.4rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); }
.osd-ch-cat { color: var(--haze); }
.osd-progress.is-live .progress-fill { background: var(--lamp); }
.osd-progress.is-live .osd-time-a { color: var(--lamp); }
.progress-fill { background: var(--lamp); }

/* =====================================================================
   Splash — the lamp switches on
   ===================================================================== */
.splash { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 80; background: var(--velvet); display: grid; place-items: center; overflow: hidden; transition: opacity 360ms var(--out); }
.splash.is-leaving { opacity: 0; }
.splash-beam {
  position: absolute; left: 50%; top: -30%; width: 120rem; height: 90rem; transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.16), rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.04) 55%, transparent 75%);
  animation: lamp-on 900ms var(--out) both;
}
@keyframes lamp-on { 0% { opacity: 0; } 30% { opacity: 0.8; } 40% { opacity: 0.3; } 100% { opacity: 1; } }
.splash-center { position: relative; text-align: center; animation: pf-rise 700ms 120ms var(--out) both; }
.wm-hero { font-size: 9rem; }
.wm-xl { font-size: 4.2rem; }
.splash-tag { margin-top: 1.4rem; font-size: 1.3rem; letter-spacing: 0.32em; color: var(--haze); }
html[lang="he"] .splash-tag { letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-size: 1.5rem; }

@media (max-aspect-ratio: 1/1) {
  :root { --edge: 2rem; --disc: 7rem; }
  .tb-nav { overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: none; margin-inline-start: 1rem; }
  .tb-clock { display: none; }
  .cat-side { width: 7rem; }
  .cat-side .cat-row-text, .cat-side .cat-side-title { display: none; }
}

/* =====================================================================
   Profile gate — "Who's watching?"
   ===================================================================== */
html.pf-open #app, html.pf-open .topbar, html.pf-open .siderail { visibility: hidden; }
html.pf-open #splash { display: none; }
.pf-gate {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 900; background: var(--velvet); color: var(--lamp);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden;
  transition: opacity 420ms var(--ease), transform 420ms var(--ease);
}
.pf-gate.is-leaving { opacity: 0; transform: scale(1.04); pointer-events: none; }
.pf-room { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.pf-room::before { /* the projector beam */
  content: ''; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: -20%; width: 120rem; height: 80rem; transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.13), rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.04) 55%, transparent 75%);
  animation: pf-breathe 7s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.pf-room::after { /* coloured ambience */
  content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(42rem 36rem at 8% 92%, rgba(255, 107, 138, 0.16), transparent 70%),
    radial-gradient(46rem 38rem at 94% 88%, rgba(139, 108, 255, 0.16), transparent 70%);
}
@keyframes pf-breathe { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.85; } 50% { opacity: 1; } }

.pf-body { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; }
.pf-body.is-in > *, .pf-body.is-in .pf-copy > *, .pf-body.is-in .pf-stage { animation: pf-rise 560ms var(--ease) both; }
.pf-body.is-in > *:nth-child(2), .pf-body.is-in .pf-copy > *:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 50ms; }
.pf-body.is-in > *:nth-child(3), .pf-body.is-in .pf-copy > *:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 100ms; }
.pf-body.is-in > *:nth-child(4), .pf-body.is-in .pf-copy > *:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 150ms; }
.pf-body.is-in .pf-copy > *:nth-child(n+5) { animation-delay: 200ms; }
.pf-body.is-in .pf-stage { animation-delay: 120ms; }
@keyframes pf-rise { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(1.2rem); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }

.pf-brand .wordmark { font-size: 2.2rem; }
.pf-title {
  margin: 1.6rem 0 3.4rem; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.4rem; line-height: 0.95;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-align: center; text-shadow: 0 0 3rem rgba(255, 243, 221, 0.18);
}

.pf-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 2.6rem 2.8rem; max-width: 104rem; padding: 1rem 2rem; }
.pf-row.is-many { gap: 2rem 2.2rem; }
.pf-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; width: 13rem; outline: none; }
.pf-row.is-many .pf-tile { width: 11rem; }
.pf-av {
  position: relative; display: block; width: 12rem; height: 12rem; border-radius: 26%;
  transition: transform 260ms var(--ease), box-shadow 260ms var(--ease), filter 260ms var(--ease);
  filter: saturate(0.72) brightness(0.82);
  box-shadow: 0 1.4rem 3rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);

  <script>/* INDTV — profiles. Anyone can register; there is no limit on the number of profiles.

     * once a second and replaced in place, so subtitles follow the speech word by word. */
    _streamDG: function (run, cfg) {
      var mime = pickMime();

      var MAXS = 5;           // at most five sentences on screen: the finished ones roll upwards, the newest is at the bottom
      function render(out) {

        if (cur.length > 170) cur = '…' + cur.slice(-168);
        var done = dg.lines.map(function (l) { return l.tr; }).filter(Boolean).slice(-(MAXS - (cur ? 1 : 0)));
        var text = done.concat(cur ? [cur] : []).join('\n').trim();
        var orig = (dg.final + ' ' + dg.interim).trim();
        if (orig.length > 100) orig = '…' + orig.slice(-98);
        LT.state.update({ text: text, lines: done, cur: cur, orig: orig, error: null });
        clearTimeout(LT._clear);
        LT._clear = setTimeout(function () { if (run === LT._run) { dg.lines = []; dg.lastTr = ''; LT.state.update({ text: '', lines: [], cur: '', orig: '' }); } }, 9000);
      }
      function translateNow() {
        if (dg.busy || run !== LT._run || Date.now() < LT._pauseUntil) return;
        var src = (dg.final + ' ' + dg.interim).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
        if (!src || src === dg.shownSrc) return;
        dg.busy = true; dg.dirty = false;
        var seq = ++dg.seq;
        fastTranslate(cfg, src, dg.prev).then(function (out) {
          dg.busy = false;
          if (run !== LT._run || seq < dg.shown) return;
          dg.shown = seq; dg.shownSrc = src;
          out = (out || '').replace(/^["“”']+|["“”']+$/g, '').trim();
          if (out) { dg.lastTr = out; render(out); }
        }).catch(function (e) {
          dg.busy = false;
          if (run !== LT._run) return;
          if (e && e.status === 429) { LT._pauseUntil = Date.now() + 2000; LT._notify(t('translateLimit')); }
          else if (e && (e.status === 401 || e.status === 403)) { LT._pauseUntil = Date.now() + 5 * 60000; LT._notify(t('translateFail')); }
          else { LT._pauseUntil = Date.now() + 1500; LT._notify(describe(e)); }
        });
      }
      /** Split text into finished sentences and the unfinished rest (Hindi danda included). */
      function splitSentences(txt) {
        var re = /[^.!?\u0964\u061F\u2026]+[.!?\u0964\u061F\u2026]+["'\u201D)\]]*\s*/g, out = [], m, last = 0;

        return { done: out, rest: txt.slice(last).trim() };
      }
      /** Move finished sentences (all of them when the speaker paused) into the rolling list and translate each one properly. */
      function commit(all) {
        var parts = splitSentences(dg.final), done = parts.done.slice(), rest = parts.rest;
        if (all && rest) { done.push(rest); rest = ''; }
        if (!done.length) return;

        dg.final = rest;
        if (all) dg.interim = '';
        dg.lastTr = ''; dg.shownSrc = ''; dg.shown = ++dg.seq;
        dg.prev = done[done.length - 1];
        var entries = done.map(function (src, i) { var e = { src: src, tr: i === 0 ? fallback : '' }; dg.lines.push(e); return e; });
        dg.lines = dg.lines.slice(-MAXS);

        entries.forEach(function (e) {
          fastTranslate(cfg, e.src, '').then(function (out) {
            if (run !== LT._run) return;
            out = (out || '').replace(/^["\u201C\u201D']+|["\u201C\u201D']+$/g, '').trim();
            if (out) e.tr = out;
            render('');
          }, function () { render(''); });
        });
      }
      function startRecorder() {
        var stream = currentStream(), rec;
        try { rec = mime ? new root.MediaRecorder(stream, { mimeType: mime, audioBitsPerSecond: 48000 }) : new root.MediaRecorder(stream); }

        rec.ondataavailable = function (ev) {
          if (run === LT._run && ev.data && ev.data.size && dg.ws && dg.ws.readyState === 1) dg.ws.send(ev.data);

        var url = cfg.base + (cfg.base.indexOf('?') < 0 ? '?' : '&') + 'model=' + encodeURIComponent(cfg.stt) +

          if (m.type !== 'Results' || !m.channel || !m.channel.alternatives || !m.channel.alternatives[0]) return;
          var alt = m.channel.alternatives[0], txt = String(alt.transcript || '').trim();

          if (dg.rec && dg.rec.state !== 'inactive') { try { dg.rec.stop(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } }

    stop: function () {

        clearInterval(LT._sx.watch);
        if (LT._sx.rec && LT._sx.rec.state !== 'inactive') { try { LT._sx.rec.stop(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } }
        if (LT._sx.ws) { try { LT._sx.ws.send(''); LT._sx.ws.close(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } }

      }
      if (LT._dg) {

        if (LT._dg.rec && LT._dg.rec.state !== 'inactive') { try { LT._dg.rec.stop(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } }

    /**

     * (or at MAX_SEG during continuous speech), so subtitles follow the speech phrase by phrase.
     * The next recorder starts immediately; requests are paced to stay inside the service's
     * per-minute limit, and results are shown strictly in order.

      clearInterval(LT._vad);
      LT._vad = setInterval(function () {
        if (run !== LT._run || rec.state === 'inactive') { clearInterval(LT._vad); return; }

        var paced = now - LT._lastSent >= LT._minGap;
        var cut = (paused && elapsed >= MIN_SEG && paced) || (elapsed >= Math.max(MAX_SEG, LT._minGap) && paced) ||
          (!voiced && elapsed >= 6000);             // nothing said: start a fresh, small chunk
        if (cut) { clearInterval(LT._vad); try { rec.stop(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } }
      }, 80);
    },

    _send: function (run, blob) {
      if (Date.now() < LT._pauseUntil || LT._inFlight >= 3) return;
      var cfg = loadCfg();
      var seq = ++LT._seq;
      LT._lastSent = Date.now();
      LT._inFlight++;
      transcribe(cfg, blob).then(function (tr) {
        if (run !== LT._run) return null;
        var text = tr.text.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
        if (!text || text.length < 2 || HALLUCINATIONS.test(text)) return null;
        var detected = tr.language ? String(tr.language).toLowerCase() : null;
        var target = TARGETS.filter(function (x) { return x.code === cfg.target; })[0] || TARGETS[0];
        var same = detected && (detected === target.code || detected === target.en.toLowerCase());
        var p = same ? Promise.resolve(text) : translate(cfg, text, LT._prev);
        return p.then(function (out) {
          if (run !== LT._run || seq < LT._shown) return;   // a newer line is already on screen
          out = (out || '').replace(/^["“”']+|["“”']+$/g, '').trim();

          LT._shown = seq;
          LT._prev = text;
          LT.state.update({ text: out, orig: text, detected: detected, error: null });
          clearTimeout(LT._clear);
          var keep = Math.min(9000, Math.max(3500, out.length * 90));
          LT._clear = setTimeout(function () { if (LT.state.get().text === out) LT.state.update({ text: '', orig: '' }); }, keep);

        } else if (e && (e.status === 401 || e.status === 403)) { LT._pauseUntil = Date.now() + 5 * 60000; msg = t('translateFail'); }
        else { LT._pauseUntil = Date.now() + 8000; msg = describe(e); }

    },

    /** Problems appear once as a short notice, never as a permanent banner over the picture. */
    _notify: function (msg) {
      var now = Date.now();
      if (msg === LT._lastNote && now - LT._lastNoteAt < 60000) return;
      LT._lastNote = msg; LT._lastNoteAt = now;

    },

    /** Settings "Save": checks the key, speech recognition and translation, and reports each step. */
    test: function () {
      var cfg = loadCfg();
      if (cfg.provider === 'deepgram') return LT._testDG(cfg);
      if (PROVIDERS[cfg.provider].api === 'stream') return LT._testStream(cfg);
      var he = INDTV.I18n.lang() === 'he';
      var report = { ok: false, lines: [] };
      return http('GET', cfg.base.replace(/\/$/, '') + '/models', { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + cfg.key, Accept: 'application/json' }, null)
        .then(function (res) {

          report.lines.push((he ? '✓ המפתח תקין' : '✓ Key accepted'));

        })
        .then(function () {
          report.lines.push((he ? '✓ זיהוי דיבור (' : '✓ Speech recognition (') + loadCfg().stt + ')');
          return translate(loadCfg(), 'नमस्ते, आप कैसे हैं?', '');
        })
        .then(function (out) {
          report.lines.push((he ? '✓ תרגום (' : '✓ Translation (') + loadCfg().llm + '): ' + (out || '—'));

        })
        .catch(function (e) {
          report.lines.push('✗ ' + (e && e.status === 401 ? t('translateFail') : describe(e)));

        });
    }
  };

  LT._testDG = function (cfg) {
    var he = INDTV.I18n.lang() === 'he';
    var lines = [];
    // 1) ask the REST API: it tells a wrong key (401/403) from a connection problem

'החיבור נדחה (' + cfg.key.length + ' תווים במפתח; בדרך כלל 40) — צרו מפתח חדש והעתיקו אותו במלואו' : 'connection refused (key has ' + cfg.key.length + ' chars; usually 40) — create a new key and copy it fully')); };

  LT._testStream = function (cfg) {

      };

  <script>/* INDTV — Home. A projection-room hero that follows the highlighted channel, then rows of round channel
 * logos: continue watching, favourites, and every category — ordered by what this profile watches and
 * browses most, so the rows you use float to the top. */
(function (root) {
  'use strict';
  var INDTV = root.INDTV = root.INDTV || {};
  var U = INDTV.Util, UI = INDTV.UI, t = function (k) { return INDTV.I18n.t(k); };

  function catLine(ch) {

    el: null, mounted: false,

    mount: function () {

      Home.el.appendChild(Home.scroller);
      Home.render();

      ['catalog', 'favorites', 'lang', 'shows'].forEach(function (evt) { INDTV.Bus.on(evt, rerender); });
      INDTV.Bus.on('catalog-status', function () { if (!CR.all().length) rerender(); });

      INDTV.Bus.on('player-closed', rerender);

    onShow: function () { if (Home._heroCh) INDTV.Ambient.channel(Home._heroCh); },
    firstFocus: function () { return Home.scroller.querySelector('.tile'); },

    setHero: function (ch) {
      Home._heroCh = ch;

      var lang = INDTV.I18n.lang();
      var meta = [];
      if (e && e.now) meta.push(U.el('span', { class: 'hero-now', dir: 'auto', text: e.now.title }), U.el('span', { text: '\u2066' + U._formatTime(e.now.start, lang) + '–' + U._formatTime(e.now.stop, lang) + '\u2069' }));

      if (INDTV.FavoritesRepository.has(ch.id)) meta.push(U.el('span', { class: 'hero-fav', html: INDTV.icon('heartFill') + U.escapeHtml(t('inFavorites')) }));
      var title = U.el('h1', { class: 'hero-title' + (ch.name.length > 18 ? ' long' : ''), dir: 'auto', text: ch.name });
      var box = U.el('div', { class: 'hero-text' }, [

      if (favs.length) { Home.scroller.appendChild(Home._row(t('yourFavorites'), U.count(favs.length, 'channel', 'channels'), favs, 'h-favs')); first = first || favs[0]; }

    }
  };

    },
    firstFocus: function () { return Settings.el.querySelector('.fx'); },

    dvrForm: function () {

      if (!D.supported()) { box.appendChild(U.el('p', { class: 'set-status', text: t('dvrUnsupported') })); return box; }

        box.appendChild(row);

      onOff(t('dvrAutoStop'), 'autoStop');
      onOff(t('dvrFromStart'), 'fromStart');
      var pad = U.el('div', { class: 'set-row', 'data-fgroup': 'set-dvr-pad' });
      [0, 2, 5, 10].forEach(function (m) {
        pad.appendChild(choice(m + ' ' + t('recMin'), cfg.padMin === m, 'dvr:pad:' + m, function () { D.saveSettings({ padMin: m }); }));
      });
      box.appendChild(U.el('span', { class: 'field-label', text: t('dvrPad') }));
      box.appendChild(pad);

    },

    build: function () {

      Settings.el.appendChild(Settings.scroller);

      var parts = {};
      function put(cat, el) { (parts[cat] = parts[cat] || []).push(el); }

      s.appendChild(U.el('div', { class: 'page-head', 'data-row': '' }, [U.el('h1', { class: 'page-title', text: t('settings') })]));
      var catRow = U.el('div', { class: 'set-row set-cats', 'data-row': '', 'data-fgroup': 'set-cats' });
      CATS.forEach(function (c) {
        var on = Settings._cat === c[0];
        catRow.appendChild(UI.button(t(c[1]), on ? 'check' : null, function () { Settings._cat = c[0]; Settings.build(); INDTV.Focus.restore('cat:' + c[0], Settings.el); },
          { cls: 'btn-choice' + (on ? ' is-on' : ''), key: 'cat:' + c[0] }));
      });
      s.appendChild(catRow);

      // Language
      var langRow = U.el('div', { class: 'set-row', 'data-fgroup': 'set-lang' });
      [['en', 'English'], ['he', 'עברית']].forEach(function (l) {
        var b = UI.button(l[1], INDTV.I18n.lang() === l[0] ? 'check' : 'globe', function () { INDTV.I18n.setLang(l[0]); }, {
          cls: 'btn-choice' + (INDTV.I18n.lang() === l[0] ? ' is-on' : ''), key: 'lang:' + l[0]
        });
        if (l[0] === 'he') b.setAttribute('lang', 'he');
        langRow.appendChild(b);
      });
      put('general', Settings.section(t('language'), langRow));

      // Display size
      var sizeRow = U.el('div', { class: 'set-row', 'data-fgroup': 'set-size' });
      [['m', 'sizeM'], ['l', 'sizeL'], ['xl', 'sizeXL']].forEach(function (z) {

      put('general', Settings.section(t('displaySize'), U.el('div', {}, [sizeRow, U.el('p', { class: 'set-status', text: t('displaySizeHint') })])));

      // Sources
      Settings.sourcesBox = U.el('div', { class: 'sources' });
      var head = U.el('div', { class: 'set-row', 'data-fgroup': 'set-src-actions' }, [
        UI.button(t('refreshAll'), 'refresh', function () {
          PR.refresh().then(function (r) {
            UI.toast(r.some(function (x) { return x.ok; }) ? t('refreshed') : t('refreshFailed'), r.some(function (x) { return x.ok; }) ? null : 'error');
          });
        }, { cls: 'btn-ghost', key: 'src:refreshall' }),
        UI.button(t('addUrl'), 'link', function () { Settings.openAdd('url'); }, { cls: 'btn-ghost', key: 'src:addurl' }),
        UI.button(t('addRaw'), 'paste', function () { Settings.openAdd('raw'); }, { cls: 'btn-ghost', key: 'src:addraw' }),
        UI.button(t('addFile'), 'file', function () { Settings.openAdd('file'); }, { cls: 'btn-ghost', key: 'src:addfile' })
      ]);
      Settings.addBox = U.el('div', { class: 'add-box' });
      put('sources', Settings.section(t('sources'), U.el('div', {}, [Settings.sourcesBox, head, Settings.addBox])));

      // Stream check: every stream of every channel, all playlists cross-matched
      var scanLine = U.el('p', { class: 'set-status' });
      var paintScan = function () {
        var S = INDTV.StreamScan, pr = S.progress(), sm = S.summary();
        if (!S.enabled()) { scanLine.textContent = t('scanIdle'); return; }
        if (pr.active) scanLine.textContent = t('scanRunning').replace('{d}', pr.done).replace('{n}', pr.total);
        else if (sm.n) scanLine.textContent = t('scanDone').replace('{ok}', sm.ok).replace('{n}', sm.n).replace('{t}', U.formatTime(sm.at, INDTV.I18n.lang()));
        else scanLine.textContent = t('scanIdle');
      };
      paintScan();
      if (!Settings._scanBound) { Settings._scanBound = true; INDTV.Bus.on('scan-progress', function () { if (Settings._paintScan) Settings._paintScan(); }); INDTV.Bus.on('scan', function () { if (Settings._paintScan) Settings._paintScan(); }); }
      Settings._paintScan = paintScan;
      var scanRow = U.el('div', { class: 'set-row', 'data-fgroup': 'set-scan' }, [
        UI.button(t('scanNow'), 'refresh', function () { INDTV.StreamScan.run(true); paintScan(); }, { cls: 'btn-ghost', key: 'scan:now' })
      ]);
      put('sources', Settings.section(t('scanTitle'), U.el('div', {}, [scanLine, scanRow])));
      Settings.renderSources();
      Settings.renderAdd();

      var autoRow = U.el('div', { class: 'set-row', 'data-fgroup': 'set-epg-auto' }, [
        UI.button(t('on'), epg.auto ? 'check' : null, function () { INDTV.EpgRepository.setAuto(true); Settings.build(); INDTV.Focus.restore('epg:auto:on', Settings.el); }, { cls: 'btn-choice' + (epg.auto ? ' is-on' : ''), key: 'epg:auto:on' }),
        UI.button(t('off'), !epg.auto ? 'check' : null, function () { INDTV.EpgRepository.setAuto(false); Settings.build(); INDTV.Focus.restore('epg:auto:off', Settings.el); }, { cls: 'btn-choice' + (!epg.auto ? ' is-on' : ''), key: 'epg:auto:off' })

      put('about', Settings.section(t('about'), U.el('div', {}, [

    section: function (title, body) {

    renderSources: function () {
      if (!Settings.sourcesBox) return;
      var activeKey = document.activeElement && Settings.sourcesBox.contains(document.activeElement) ? document.activeElement.getAttribute('data-key') : null;
      Settings.sourcesBox.innerHTML = '';

        var card = U.el('div', { class: 'src-card' + (src.enabled ? '' : ' is-off'), 'data-fgroup': 'src-' + src.id });

          U.el('span', { class: 'src-name', text: src.name }),
          U.el('span', { class: 'tag' + (src.type === 'builtin' ? ' tag-accent' : ''), text: src.type === 'builtin' ? t('builtIn') : t('userSource') }),
          U.el('span', { class: 'tag tag-muted', text: src.kind === 'vod' ? t('kindVod') : t('kindLive') }),
          U.el('span', { class: 'src-state st-' + (src.status || 'idle'), text: status })
        ]));

        card.appendChild(U.el('p', { class: 'src-url', dir: 'ltr', text: where }));
        var facts = [
          t('lastRefresh') + ': ' + U.timeAgo(src.lastRefresh, INDTV.I18n.lang()),
          src.count ? src.count + ' ' + t('channels') : null
        ];
        if (src.stats) {
          facts.push('tvg-id ' + src.stats.withTvgId, 'tvg-name ' + src.stats.withTvgName, 'tvg-logo ' + src.stats.withLogo, 'group-title ' + src.stats.withGroup);

    openAdd: function (mode) {

    renderAdd: function () {
      var box = Settings.addBox;
      box.innerHTML = '';
      var mode = Settings.addMode;

      } else if (mode === 'raw') {

          cls: 'btn-choice' + (Settings.addKind === k[0] ? ' is-on' : ''), key: 'add:kind:' + k[0]
        }));

    renderEpgStatus: function () {

    translateForm: function () {

      });
      secs['service'].push(provRow);
      secs['service'].push(U.el('p', { class: 'set-status', text: cfg.provider === 'deepgram' ? t('deepgramHint') : cfg.provider === 'soniox' ? t('sonioxHint') : cfg.provider === 'groq' ? t('groqHint') : '' }));

      var keyIn = U.el('input', { class: 'fx field', id: 'tr-key', type: 'password', autocomplete: 'off', spellcheck: 'false', dir: 'ltr',
        placeholder: cfg.provider === 'deepgram' ? 'Deepgram API key' : cfg.provider === 'groq' ? 'gsk_…' : cfg.provider === 'soniox' ? 'Soniox API key' : 'sk-…', value: cfg.key, dataset: { key: 'tr:key' } });

        secs['service'].push(U.el('label', { class: 'field-label', for: 'tr-key2', text: t('groqKeyLabel') }));

        var b = UI.button(tg.name, on ? 'check' : null, function () { LT.saveConfig({ target: tg.code }); rebuild('tr:tg:' + tg.code); },
          { cls: 'btn-choice' + (on ? ' is-on' : ''), key: 'tr:tg:' + tg.code });
        b.setAttribute('lang', tg.code);

      var mark = PS.progress.querySelector('.prog-mark');

        b.textContent = U.formatDuration(st.duration);

          // and a tick shows where the saved buffer begins (that is as far back as you can go).

          fill.style.width = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round((at - epg.now.start) / len * 100))) + '%';
          a.textContent = U.formatTime(epg.now.start, INDTV.I18n.lang());
          b.textContent = U.formatTime(epg.now.stop, INDTV.I18n.lang());

          U.el('span', { class: 'status-icon', html: INDTV.icon('alert') }),

          U.el('span', { class: 'osd-now-row' }, [U.el('span', { class: 'osd-now-title', text: prog.title }), heart])

    },

    /* ---------- live translation overlay ---------- */
    renderSubs: function (ts) {

  <script>/* INDTV — Live. One screen, streaming-service style: a framed billboard for the channel to watch now,

    return Cat.of(ch).slice(0, 2).map(function (id) { return Cat.name(id); }).join(' • ');
  }
  function nowLine(ch) {
    var e = INDTV.EpgRepository.nowNext(ch);
    if (!e || !e.now) return null;
    var lang = INDTV.I18n.lang();
    return { title: e.now.title, time: '⁦' + U._formatTime(e.now.start, lang) + '–' + U._formatTime(e.now.stop, lang) + '⁩' };
  }
  function play(ch, ids) {
    INDTV.Router.openPlayer({ kind: 'channel', id: ch.id }, { list: ids || [ch.id] });
  }

  // ---- hold OK on a channel = favourite (only once this TV has shown it delivers key-up events)
  var LP = { seenUp: false, down: false, done: false, el: null, timer: 0 };
  function toggleFav(ch) {
    var added = Fav.toggle(ch.id);
    UI.toast(added ? '♥ ' + ch.name + ' נוסף למועדפים' : ch.name + ' הוסר מהמועדפים');
  }

  var Live = {
    el: null, mounted: false,

    mount: function () {
      Live.el = document.getElementById('screen-home');
      Live.el.innerHTML = '';
      Live.el.classList.add('lh');
      Live.scroller = U.el('div', { class: 'vscroll lh-scroll', 'data-top-offset': '0' });
      Live.el.appendChild(Live.scroller);
      Live.el.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) { var k = e.target.getAttribute && e.target.getAttribute('data-key'); if (k) Live._lastKey = k; });
      Live.render();
      var rerender = U.debounce(function () { if (Live.mounted) Live.render(); }, 250);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- billboard
    _billboard: function (ch, ids) {
      var now = nowLine(ch);
      var fav = Fav.has(ch.id);
      var playBtn = U.el('button', { class: 'fx lh-btn lh-play', type: 'button', dataset: { key: 'lh:play' }, html: INDTV.icon('play') + '<span>צפייה בשידור חי</span>' });
      playBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { play(ch, ids); });
      var favBtn = U.el('button', { class: 'fx lh-btn lh-favbtn' + (fav ? ' is-on' : ''), type: 'button', dataset: { key: 'lh:fav' },
        html: INDTV.icon(fav ? 'heartFill' : 'heart') + '<span>' + (fav ? 'במועדפים' : 'הוספה למועדפים') + '</span>' });
      favBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { toggleFav(ch); });
      [playBtn, favBtn].forEach(function (b) { b.addEventListener('focus', function () { INDTV.Ambient.channel(ch); }); });
      var meta = [U.el('span', { class: 'lh-live', html: '<i></i>שידור חי' })];
      var cl = catLine(ch);
      if (cl) meta.push(U.el('span', { text: cl }));
      var art = U.el('div', { class: 'lh-bb-art', style: '--cat:' + Cat.color(Cat.of(ch)[0]) }, [UI.logo(ch, { cls: 'lh-bb-logo', eager: true, showName: false })]);
      var info = U.el('div', { class: 'lh-bb-info' }, [
        U.el('div', { class: 'lh-kicker', text: INDTV.RecentRepository.channels()[0] === ch ? 'המשך לצפות' : 'מומלץ עכשיו' }),
        U.el('h1', { class: 'lh-bb-title' + (ch.name.length > 20 ? ' long' : ''), dir: 'auto', text: ch.name }),
        U.el('div', { class: 'lh-meta' }, meta),
        now ? U.el('div', { class: 'lh-now' }, [U.el('span', { class: 'lh-now-k', text: 'עכשיו:' }), U.el('span', { dir: 'auto', text: now.title }), U.el('span', { class: 'lh-now-t', text: now.time })]) : null,
        U.el('div', { class: 'lh-actions', 'data-fgroup': 'lh-bb' }, [playBtn, favBtn])
      ]);
      return U.el('section', { class: 'lh-bb-row', 'data-row': '', 'data-row-top': '' }, [U.el('div', { class: 'lh-bb' }, [art, U.el('div', { class: 'lh-bb-shade' }), info])]);

      if (Fav.has(ch.id)) art.appendChild(U.el('span', { class: 'lh-heart', html: INDTV.icon('heartFill') }));
      if (INDTV.StreamScan && INDTV.StreamScan.enabled() && INDTV.StreamScan.channelState(ch) === 'dead') b.classList.add('is-off');

      var state = CR.state.get();
      var S = Live.scroller;
      S.innerHTML = '';
      if (!state.channels.length) { S.appendChild(INDTV.HomeScreen._stateView(state)); return; }

      var recent = INDTV.RecentRepository.channels();
      var favs = Fav.channels();
      var pop = INDTV.popularChannels(24);
      var featured = recent[0] || favs[0] || pop[0];
      var cats = Cat.ranked();
      if (featured) S.appendChild(Live._billboard(featured, (recent.length ? recent : pop).map(function (c) { return c.id; })));
      if (cats.length > 1) S.appendChild(Live._catTiles(cats));
      if (favs.length) S.appendChild(Live._row('המועדפים שלי', favs.length + ' ערוצים', favs, 'lh-favs'));
      if (recent.length) S.appendChild(Live._row('צפית לאחרונה', '', recent.slice(0, 20), 'lh-recent'));
      if (!recent.length && !favs.length) S.appendChild(Live._row('הכי נצפים', '', pop, 'lh-pop'));

      // category rows are built a few at a time as you move down
      Live._cats = cats; Live._built = 0;
      Live._more = function (n) {

          var row = Live._row(Cat.name(c.id), c.count + ' ערוצים', INDTV.StreamScan.sort(c.channels), 'lh-c-' + U.hash(c.id));

      Live.mountedOnce = true;
      if (want && /^lh-c-/.test(want)) Live._more(cats.length);
      var back = want ? Live.el.querySelector('[data-key="' + want.replace(/"/g, '\\"') + '"]') : null;

        var chId = want.slice(want.indexOf(':') + 1);

      }

    }
  };

  <script>/* INDTV — automatic updates. On every launch the app asks whether a newer build of INDTV was published;
 * if so it downloads it (one small file), keeps it, and applies it by itself: right away when nothing is
 * playing, otherwise the next time the app opens. Nothing to download or install by hand. */
(function (root) {
  'use strict';
  var INDTV = root.INDTV = root.INDTV || {};
  var URL_OTA = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/liors24/indtv/ota/bundle.json';

  function current() {
    var b = typeof root.INDTV_BUILD === 'number' ? root.INDTV_BUILD : 0, o = 0;
    try { var s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('indtv:ota') || 'null'); o = s && s.build || 0; } catch (e) { o = 0; }
    var bad = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('indtv:ota-bad'), 10) || 0;   // a build that failed to start is never retried
    return Math.max(b, o, bad);
  }
  function playing() { var p = document.getElementById('player'); return !!(p && !p.hidden); }

  function restart() { try { root.location.replace(new URL('index.html', root.location.href).href); } catch (e) { root.location.reload(); } }

  var Updater = {
    build: function () { return current(); },
    check: function () {
      if (!INDTV_BUILD_OK()) return Promise.resolve(false);
      return fetch(URL_OTA + '?t=' + Date.now(), { cache: 'no-store', credentials: 'omit' })
        .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status); return r.json(); })
        .then(function (b) {
          if (!b || !b.html || !(b.build > current()) || b.html.indexOf('INDTV') < 0) return false;
          localStorage.setItem('indtv:ota', JSON.stringify({ build: b.build, html: b.html }));
          localStorage.removeItem('indtv:ota-boot');
          Updater.apply();
          return true;
        })
        .catch(function () { return false; });   // offline or blocked: keep what is installed
    },
    /** Reload now if nothing is playing; otherwise wait for the player to close. */
    apply: function () {
      if (!playing()) { restart(); return; }
      INDTV.UI.toast(INDTV.I18n.lang() === 'he' ? 'יצאה גרסה חדשה — תותקן כשתסגרו את הנגן' : 'New version ready — it will apply when you close the player');
      var iv = setInterval(function () { if (!playing()) { clearInterval(iv); restart(); } }, 3000);
    }
  };
  function INDTV_BUILD_OK() { return typeof root.fetch === 'function' && typeof root.localStorage !== 'undefined'; }

  INDTV.Updater = Updater;
})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis);
</script>
  <script>/* INDTV — boot. Splash → cached catalog → background playlist refresh → Home. */
(function (root) {
  'use strict';
  var INDTV = root.INDTV;

  function withTimeout(p, ms) {
    return Promise.race([p, new Promise(function (r) { setTimeout(r, ms); })]);
  }

  // Live only: one screen of live channels. No catch-up, recordings, translation, profiles or settings.
  INDTV.LIVE_ONLY = true;

  function registerScreens() {
    var R = INDTV.Router;
    if (INDTV.LIVE_ONLY) {
      R.register('home', INDTV.LiveHome);
      R.screens.home.el = document.getElementById('screen-home');
      return;
    }
    R.register('home', INDTV.HomeScreen);
    R.register('categories', INDTV.CategoriesScreen);
    R.register('catchup', INDTV.CatchUpScreen);
    R.register('favorites', INDTV.FavoritesScreen);
    R.register('recordings', INDTV.RecordingsScreen);
    R.register('settings', INDTV.SettingsScreen);
    Object.keys(R.screens).forEach(function (k) {
      R.screens[k].el = document.getElementById('screen-' + k);
    });
  }

  function boot() {
    if (root.INDTVNative) document.documentElement.classList.add('is-native');
    // Samsung Tizen app: ask the TV to deliver the remote's media and channel keys to INDTV.
    if (root.tizen && root.tizen.tvinputdevice) {
      document.documentElement.classList.add('is-tizen', 'is-native');
      ['MediaPlayPause', 'MediaPlay', 'MediaPause', 'MediaStop', 'MediaFastForward', 'MediaRewind',
        'ChannelUp', 'ChannelDown', 'ColorF0Red', 'ColorF1Green', 'ColorF2Yellow', 'ColorF3Blue'].forEach(function (k) {
        try { root.tizen.tvinputdevice.registerKey(k); } catch (e) { /* key not on this model */ }
      });
    }
    INDTV.I18n.applyDir();
    INDTV.Display.apply();
    INDTV.Focus.start();
    INDTV.EditDock.start();
    INDTV.Router.start();
    registerScreens();

    root.INDTVKey = function (key) {
      var target = document.activeElement || document.body;
      target.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: key, bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));
      return 'ok';
    };

    if (INDTV.LIVE_ONLY) {
      document.documentElement.classList.add('live');
      // one viewer: reuse the last profile (keeps existing favourites), or make one quietly
      var P = INDTV.Profiles, list = P.list();
      var id = P.lastId() && P.get(P.lastId()) ? P.lastId() : (list[0] ? list[0].id : P.create('ראשי', (INDTV.Avatars && INDTV.Avatars.ids[0]) || null).id);
      P.use(id).then(function (p) { start(p); }, function () { start(null); });
      try { localStorage.removeItem('indtv:ota-boot'); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
      return;
    }
    // 0. "Who's watching?" — every person gets their own favourites, history and recordings.
    INDTV.ProfileGate.open().then(function (p) {
      try { localStorage.removeItem('indtv:ota-boot'); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
      start(p);
    });
    try { localStorage.removeItem('indtv:ota-boot'); } catch (e) { /* the gate rendered: this bundle runs */ }
  }

  function start() {
    // 1. Local data only (IndexedDB). Capped so a slow storage layer never holds the splash.
    var local = Promise.all([
      INDTV.PlaylistRepository.init(),
      INDTV.FavoritesRepository.load(),
      INDTV.RecentRepository.load(),
      INDTV.EpgRepository.load(),
      INDTV.ShowFavorites.load(),
      INDTV.Categories.load(),
      INDTV.StreamScan.load()
    ]).then(function () { return INDTV.VodRepository.load(); });

    withTimeout(local, 900).then(function () {
      // 2. Start the playlist refresh in the background; the splash does not wait for it.
      if (INDTV.PlaylistRepository.shouldAutoRefresh()) INDTV.PlaylistRepository.refresh();
      // Programme guide: downloaded and parsed in the background once Home is up (never blocks the UI).
      setTimeout(function () { INDTV.EpgRepository.ensureFresh(); }, 3500);
      if (!INDTV.LIVE_ONLY) INDTV.ShowFavorites.startWatcher();
      INDTV.StreamScan.start();
      if (INDTV.DVR && !INDTV.LIVE_ONLY) INDTV.DVR.load();
      INDTV.PlaylistRepository.startBackgroundPolicy();

      // 3. Build the shell under the splash so Home is ready the moment it lifts.
      INDTV.Router.buildChrome();
      INDTV.PlayerScreen.build();
      var tab = INDTV.Router.initialTab();
      INDTV.Router.go(tab);
      var splash = INDTV.Splash.show(1100);
      return splash.then(function () {
        document.documentElement.classList.add('is-ready');
        INDTV.Router.focusNav(tab);
        try { localStorage.removeItem('indtv:ota-boot'); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }   // this bundle started fine
        setTimeout(function () { INDTV.Updater.check(); }, 4000);
      });
    });

    INDTV.Bus.on('lang', function () {
      var focusedKey = document.activeElement && document.activeElement.getAttribute('data-key');
      INDTV.Router.buildChrome();
      if (focusedKey) INDTV.Focus.restore(focusedKey);
    });

    // Top bar turns solid once the current screen scrolls under it.
    document.addEventListener('scroll', function (e) {
      var t = e.target;
      if (t && t.classList && t.classList.contains('vscroll') && !t.closest('[hidden]')) {
        document.documentElement.classList.toggle('is-scrolled', t.scrollTop > 24);
      }
    }, true);
    INDTV.Bus.on('tab', function () {
      var s = document.querySelector('.screen:not([hidden]) .vscroll');
      document.documentElement.classList.toggle('is-scrolled', !!s && s.scrollTop > 24);
    });

    // keep relative times and programme progress fresh without re-fetching
    setInterval(function () { INDTV.Bus.emit('epg'); }, 5 * 60 * 1000);

    // Android TV app shell: remote keys the WebView does not deliver (Back, channel, media) arrive here.
    root.INDTVKey = function (key) {
      var target = document.activeElement || document.body;
      target.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: key, bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));
      return 'ok';
    };

    if (!root.INDTVNative && 'serviceWorker' in navigator && /^https?:$/.test(location.protocol)) {
      navigator.serviceWorker.register('sw.js').catch(function () { /* optional */ });
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
  else boot();
})(window);
</script>
